Brown Rudnick Helps Fundraise Up Secure $70M Growth Capital Investment

Published On: 02/24/2025

RELATED EXPERIENCE

[FINANCE](https://brownrudnick.com/practice/finance/)

[CAPITAL MARKETS](https://brownrudnick.com/industry/capital-markets/)

[EMERGING GROWTH COMPANIES & VENTURE CAPITAL](https://brownrudnick.com/industry/venture-capital-1/)

[FINTECH](https://brownrudnick.com/practice/fintech/)

Brown Rudnick served as legal counsel to Fundraise Up, a fundraising platform for nonprofits, in securing a $70 million growth capital investment.

Fundraise Up announced the transaction on Jan. 23, 2025. The investment will fuel the company’s AI-powered innovation and global expansion, enhancing online fundraising impact for nonprofits worldwide.

The Series B financing was led by Boston-based Summit Partners and included participation from existing investor Telescope Partners.

Co-founded in 2017 by Anton Isaykin, Peter Byrnes and Yuriy Smirnov, Fundraise Up was created to help nonprofits raise more money online. It is the first platform to use predictive AI in donor experiences and is designed to address the inefficiencies and complexities of traditional online donation processes. Among the organizations that use this platform are UNICEF USA, The Salvation Army UK, the Canadian Red Cross and the American Heart Association.

The Brown Rudnick team was led by partner [Jared Sorin](https://brownrudnick.com/people/jared-m-sorin/). He also advised Fundraise Up in its Series A financing.
